g.text: A motif scanner is a sliding dot product
Worked example: a 3-base filter scores each window of A C G T A C.
Toy weights, not a learned motif or probability matrix. A high score does not establish binding in a cell.
Schematic / worked example · not experimental data · ickma.dev
